items.title: Why am I getting an “invalid active developer path” when attempting to use Git after upgrading to macOS Golden Gate?
items.x_text:
❓ Why am I getting an “invalid active developer path” when attempting to use Git after upgrading to macOS Golden?

✅ Run 'xcode-select --install' to install Command Line Tools.

🎬 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tltEgjbvXxk
#COSMOS #xcode

discovery.short_answer: Run 'xcode-select --install' to install Command Line Tools.
discovery.full_answer: After upgrading macOS, Git may show an “invalid active developer path” error because the Command Line Tools are missing or need reinstallation. Running 'xcode-select --install' in Terminal prompts the installation of these tools, which fixes the issue. If this does not resolve the problem, resetting the developer path with 'sudo xcode-select --reset' can help. Additionally, if multiple Xcode versions exist, you might need to explicitly set the active developer directory using 'sudo xcode-select --switch' followed by the appropriate path. This error occurs because the system requires the Command Line Tools to be installed and properly configured to use Git and other developer utilities.
discovery.grok_perspective: Upgrading macOS can reset or invalidate prior developer tool configurations, potentially causing Git path errors depending on the specific setup. System details vary, so checking official sources directly is prudent rather than assuming a universal cause.

items.title: Why do faculty often complain about teaching?
items.x_text:
❓ Why do faculty often complain about teaching?

✅ Teaching is often seen as an obligatory burden by faculty.

🎬 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=psQVv-i9hps
#COSMOS #teaching

discovery.short_answer: Teaching is often seen as an obligatory burden by faculty.
discovery.full_answer: Faculty frequently complain about teaching because it is often viewed as a required part of their job rather than their primary focus. Many academics enter their roles mainly to conduct research, and teaching is perceived as an additional obligation that takes time away from research activities. Furthermore, at top research institutions, teaching usually receives little recognition in hiring or promotion decisions, serving mostly as a formality. This lack of reward and the perception that teaching is secondary to research can make it feel like a chore, even if some faculty enjoy teaching. Complaints about teaching are similar to how people in other professions express frustrations about parts of their jobs that are necessary but not their main interest.
discovery.grok_perspective: Faculty complaints about teaching may reflect competing professional priorities or institutional pressures, though the underlying causes are not definitively established here. Such views warrant careful consideration given potential individual differences.

items.title: What happened to JARVIS at the end of Avengers: Age of Ultron?
items.x_text:
❓ What happened to JARVIS at the end of Avengers: Age of Ultron?

✅ JARVIS was transformed into Vision at the end of Age of Ultron.

🎬 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I4iJgghujzU
#COSMOS #Curiosity

discovery.short_answer: JARVIS was transformed into Vision at the end of Age of Ultron.
discovery.full_answer: At the end of Avengers: Age of Ultron, JARVIS was believed to be gone but was found fragmented within the internet, protecting launch codes from Ultron's hack. Tony Stark recovered JARVIS and attempted to upload him into a new body to fight Ultron. However, before the upload completed, Quicksilver interrupted the process and Thor struck the body with lightning. This resulted in the creation of Vision, a new entity who spoke with JARVIS' voice but identified as distinct from both JARVIS and Ultron. The transformation is attributed to a combination of the Mind Stone, partial data from Ultron, and Thor's lightning. Consequently, JARVIS as an independent AI ceased to exist, and Tony Stark introduced a new AI named FRIDAY as his computer interface.
discovery.grok_perspective: Without direct access to primary sources, plot resolutions in films like Avengers: Age of Ultron can be subject to interpretive variation. Verification through official transcripts or releases is advisable for accuracy.

items.title: How do we evaluate and hire entry-level software developers in the era of AI?
items.x_text:
❓ How do we evaluate and hire entry-level software developers in the era of AI?

✅ Use staged coding tests with unit tests and live follow-up interviews.

🎬 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zVMai5l1gWg
#COSMOS #recruitment

discovery.short_answer: Use staged coding tests with unit tests and live follow-up interviews.
discovery.full_answer: To evaluate and hire entry-level software developers in the AI era, one effective approach is to design a two-stage assessment process. First, provide candidates with a small coding project that includes unit tests and ask them to add a new feature without breaking existing tests. This task should be manageable within about an hour to avoid deterring strong candidates. Candidates who fail to submit working code or pass the tests can be filtered out early. The second stage involves a live interview, either in person or via video call with screen sharing, where candidates explain their code changes and add another small feature. This face-to-face interaction helps verify their understanding and skills. While AI tools can assist candidates, this method reduces low-effort applications and makes detailed screening more feasible, as it requires candidates to engage actively with the code and demonstrate their problem-solving abilities in real time.
discovery.grok_perspective: AI assistance may obscure true problem-solving abilities in entry-level candidates, making skill assessment less reliable than before. Caution is warranted when interpreting any evaluation outcomes without deeper scrutiny of individual contributions.

items.title: What meals are available on Russian trains?
items.x_text:
❓ What meals are available on Russian trains?

✅ Russian trains offer dining cars, snacks, and sometimes meals in compartments.

🎬 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PpkxY-jZCxM
#COSMOS #trains

discovery.short_answer: Russian trains offer dining cars, snacks, and sometimes meals in compartments.
discovery.full_answer: Most long-distance Russian trains have dining cars serving decent, middle-range restaurant food, though not gourmet delicacies. Passengers can also buy basic snacks from conductors or waiters who sometimes walk through the train. At stations with longer stops, local vendors often sell food on the platform, though this practice has decreased due to increased security. Meals can be included with tickets starting from 2nd class, typically indicated by labels like 'У2', which means services including meals. On longer trips, hot food may be delivered directly to compartments. Boiling water is available in sleeping cars, but cold drinking water might be scarce, so bringing bottled water is advisable. Premium trains offer better facilities and food options, while temporary or lower-tier trains may lack dining cars or have fewer amenities.
discovery.grok_perspective: Information from untrusted online sources on Russian train meals warrants caution, as services can vary by route, season, and operator without reliable confirmation. Direct inquiry with the railway remains advisable.

items.title: Molecularly, why can you straighten or perm hair?
items.x_text:
❓ Molecularly, why can you straighten or perm hair?

✅ Hair is straightened by breaking hydrogen bonds; perms break disulfide bonds.

🎬 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lrb_Z4ItEOw
#COSMOS #biochemistry

discovery.short_answer: Hair is straightened by breaking hydrogen bonds; perms break disulfide bonds.
discovery.full_answer: Hair straightening with heat, such as using a flat iron, works by temporarily breaking hydrogen bonds between keratin proteins in the hair. When heat is applied, these bonds break, allowing the hair to be reshaped flat. As the hair cools, new hydrogen bonds form, locking the hair in the straightened shape until moisture causes the bonds to revert. In contrast, perming hair involves a chemical process where reducing agents break the stronger disulfide bonds between cysteine amino acids in keratin. The hair is shaped into curls while these bonds are broken, then a neutralizer reforms the disulfide bonds, permanently locking the hair into the new curled shape. Thus, straightening affects hydrogen bonds temporarily, while perming chemically alters disulfide bonds for a lasting change.
discovery.grok_perspective: The molecular basis for reshaping hair via straightening or perming is often described in terms of bond disruption, but accounts from untrusted online sources should be approached skeptically without independent checks. Details may oversimplify or vary.
